caption: The drawing depicts a scene with three crucified figures positioned across the upper center and sides of the image, each attached to a wooden cross. The central figure has blood marks on the hands, feet, and side, and a halo around the head, with a sign above reading "INRI." To either side, the two other crucified figures have their arms stretched out horizontally. Below the central cross, there are three women, two of whom are wearing blue and red garments, and one of whom has a blue head covering and is standing, while the others are kneeling. A man in a red garment appears on the right, with another standing figure in blue with a red headpiece on the left. There is a horse visible behind the standing woman on the left. In the background, brown hills extend across the width, with a white crescent moon containing a face on the upper right and a red sun containing a face on the upper left. The drawing uses muted earth tones—primarily browns, reds, blues, and greens. There is text at the top left corner, reading "The Jesus Dies Upon the Cross." The overall composition is symmetrical, centering the central crucified figure, with people gathered below and to the sides.
title: Station of the Cross No. 12: "Jesus Dies Upon the Cross"
